answers.core: As far as I'm aware, it's not possible to extend/modify GDScript itself from an extension or addon, if one wants to use an annotation for this. It would certainly be possible to use a GDExtension adding some extra object type/class to handle this, obviously.
answers.workaround: I don't see any simple way around this directly. One would always have to fall back to C# or a GDExtension.

title: GDScript: Add a new annotation to make direct calls into native libraries without writing an extension
